text.text_excerpt: I really like this shop. It's moderately priced, with tons of cute stuff for your kitchen or someone else's kitchen if you're in the giving mood. I almost bought a wine bottle stopper in the shape of a large diamond, but then I remembered that the top shelf of my fridge can barely fit a wine bottle as is! There are lots of towels, coasters, kitchen gadgets and items for entertaining with cutesy New Orleans phrases or decor. Unlike some of the crowded shops around here, namely the voodoo souvenir shops, the traffic pattern in here makes sense. I could walk around the entire store without feeling like I was going to bump into something or someone.

We stopped in here while walking through the French Quarter. I was intrigued by their window displays and had to pop my head into the store to check them out. I soon found myself shopping with the BF in tow. It's a very cool, unique kitchen store, right up my alley. It's the perfect shop to find a gift for the foodie in your life, as well as others. You can find some of everything in here, from: food items, kitchen gadgets, dishes, party favors, wine stoppers, cook books and more. This store is also great for those of us who enjoy hosting. It is truly a gem of a store with nice employees and really interesting, unique, fun items.

This is a great spot for souvenir shopping in the French Quarter! I actually went in here 2 separate times and did the majority of my souvenir shopping here. The prices were good, and the store pretty much has something NOLA for everybody! I wound up getting a couple coffee mugs, some magnets, some pralines, some Cajun seasoning, and some Cafe De Monde beignet mix, all for a good price. I also wound up getting some Tobasco flavored chocolate for myself, which was interesting to say the least, lol. The service here was also friendly as well. I definitely recommend this store for your Nola souvenir shopping!
